decisions.reason: As an already well-accepted renamed trommel screen that has survived several years, it likely remains above aspiration and would be retained.
This multi-model mobile shredder line fits the firm's core capabilities and, absent signs of underperformance, a boundedly rational management would continue it.
The stationary electric fine shredder is more niche and thus faces some risk if results lag aspirations, but its fit with resource-saving stationary solutions supports keeping it for now.
A dedicated multi-model pre-shredder line with strong strategic fit to the firm's stationary recycling portfolio is likely performing well enough to stay on the market.
